description:
Hi! I’m Olesya, 16. I love astronomy, history, literature, geography, music, drawing, chess, and entomology. I study English and other languages, do archery, write scripts and character concepts.

For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, I made a solo project that explains space through visuals, not complex formulas—so it won’t give you a headache. It’s for youth and general audiences. I did research, texts, visuals, and organization myself, and I’m ready to keep developing it independently.
